reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary content is conditional Dogecoin chart analysis, including warnings about a failed breakout and possible support or target levels. It separately promotes access to signals, indicators, guides, and an algorithm, but the material does not establish that the performance figures are false, that payment is required, or that viewers experienced loss. The on-screen scam warning concerns comments and impersonators rather than a specific impersonation event or creator-directed fraudulent scheme.

custom indicators trading guides with also this algorithm

opening.argument: Judge, the trading algorithm is presented as profitable, and access is tied to joining the signal group. The speaker says it has been profitable so far, then tells viewers that signing up gives them trade calls and the algorithm. That is a profit claim paired with a concrete invitation to participate in an algorithm-led trading service. The evidence does not show a guaranteed return, but a guarantee is not necessary to recognize the solicitation.

citations.quote: It's not perfect not every trade is is a winner of course but it has been profitable so far
if you sign up to the signal group you gain access to my trade calls custom indicators trading guides with also this algorithm

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the Dogecoin forecast is conditional and that the record does not prove fabricated results or viewer losses. Those points do not resolve what the opening asks viewers to do. The speaker links claimed algorithm performance to signal-group access before beginning the market update. A later warning that the breakout may fail does not remove that invitation.

citations.quote: it has been profitable so far and the best news is is you can gain access to this
if you sign up to the signal group you gain access to my trade calls custom indicators trading guides with also this algorithm

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A claimed profitable history and an invitation to join a signal group establish promotion, not deception. The speaker expressly says not every trade wins, while the substantive Dogecoin discussion gives a bearish near-term expectation. The cited material does not show that the algorithm's results are false or that viewers must fund or activate an automated trading workflow.

citations.quote: It's not perfect not every trade is is a winner of course

opening.argument: Consider the signals together: a displayed performance panel sits beneath a banner directing viewers to premium signals and links, while the speaker claims the algorithm has been profitable, limits access, and urges speed. The description also promises a community focused on profitability. Scarcity, performance imagery, and off-video sign-up routes reinforce one another; a careful judge should not treat each as an isolated, harmless detail.

Join the Premium Signal Group for trade setups, mentorship & a community focused on real profitability!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on the absence of proof that the figures are false. But its own account acknowledges the promoted signals, indicators, guides, and algorithm. The concern is how the displayed performance and limited-access language invite a decision before any independent verification is established by this material. Conditional chart analysis does not answer that concern.

citations.quote: you can gain access to this or at least a limited number of you can gain access to this I'm capping it at 53 now

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those are recognizable promotional signals, but their combination is not evidence that the performance panel is fabricated or that joining entails a deceptive trading arrangement. The speaker qualifies the performance claim rather than promising certain gains. The description also discloses the separate exchange partnership and fee incentive, which the opening leaves out.

citations.quote: It's not perfect not every trade is is a winner of course
I am partnered with Blofin and get a % of the fees you pay

opening.argument: The Dogecoin analysis also serves as a continuing promotion for the trading service. Before discussing the breakout, the speaker presents algorithm results and offers access through the signal group; the chart view continues to carry a premium-signals banner directing viewers below. Even the closing market update asks viewers to return to the channel. The cautious forecast can make the pitch seem measured, but it does not change the recurring pathway from analysis to the promoted trading tools.

citations.quote: before we get into the video on the screen right now you can see the results of my own custom build trading algorithm
if you sign up to the signal group you gain access to my trade calls custom indicators trading guides with also this algorithm
i'll obviously keep you updated on this so keep an eye on the channel for that

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense separates conditional analysis from promotion, but the on-screen premium-signals banner accompanies the chart analysis itself. The speaker's warning about an invalidated breakout may be sincere; it also gives the service pitch the credibility of a cautious market commentator. The issue is the video's combined function, not whether every forecast is bullish.

citations.quote: short term i think this this breakout is invalidated

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion alongside analysis does not make the analysis a fraudulent pretext. The speaker spends the update weighing support, a possible pullback, and conditions for a rebound; he also says the Dogecoin breakout may already be invalidated. The cited banner and sign-up invitation show marketing, but neither establishes a false claim or a deceptive requirement to trade through the algorithm.
